title: Nexus Cloud Orchestrator
summary: A distributed container monitoring and auto-scaling telemetry control plane with real-time WebSocket metrics and predictive load heuristics.
overview: Nexus is an enterprise-grade telemetry dashboard and container scaling daemon built for modern microservice clusters.
challenge: Handling concurrent streams of heartbeats and node telemetry without degrading UI render frames.
solution: Architected a dual-buffer WebSocket client in React combined with an in-memory Redis ring buffer on the backend.
keyFeatures: Real-time bidirectional WebSocket metric streaming with automatic reconnection
Intelligent heuristic scaling recommendations based on sliding window CPU/RAM utilization
Zero-trust RBAC cluster authentication with fine-grained API scopes

title: Aura Neural Code Copilot
summary: Context-aware developer workspace and intelligent code audit assistant powered by large language models with automated AST parsing.
overview: Aura is an interactive developer workbench that parses repository abstract syntax trees (AST) to generate context-grounded refactoring suggestions.
challenge: Minimizing token overhead while passing multi-file repository context to LLM APIs.
solution: Designed a vector chunking pipeline utilizing tree-sitter AST nodes to extract only relevant signatures.
keyFeatures: Semantic codebase search across thousands of files using vector embeddings
Instant security scanner highlighting SQL injection vulnerabilities
One-click pull request code summary generator

title: Velox High-Throughput Ledger
summary: Double-entry bookkeeping engine with cryptographic audit trails, handling simulated high-concurrency micro-settlements with ACID guarantees.
overview: Velox is a hardened transactional banking engine implementing pure double-entry ledger bookkeeping.
challenge: Preventing race conditions and balance overdrafts during concurrent write surges.
solution: Engineered pessimistic row-level locking on account balances coupled with serialized transaction isolation levels.
keyFeatures: Strict double-entry bookkeeping guarantees (Assets = Liabilities + Equity)
Cryptographic merkle-tree verification for transaction batch integrity
Comprehensive REST API with idempotency key deduplication headers
